links.outcome: Robustness of LLM information extraction and summarization from nursing notes
links.effect: Robustness was low: 4.00% for NER and 4.31% for summarization, despite fairness of 99.9% and bias of 0.11%.
links.quote: However, robustness remained low (4.00 % for NER, 4.31 % for summarization) despite excellent fairness (99.9 %) and minimal bias (0.11 %) in both tasks.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented generation frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) to improve clinical information extraction
Few-shot prompt configuration selection (three-shot for NER, five-shot for summarization)

screen.reason: The study benchmarks 17 LLMs on clinical information extraction from nursing notes, evaluating deployment practices including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and varying few-shot prompting configurations, along with safety and equity metrics such as robustness and fairness.
